name: Battlement-Forged
text: Made from the same stone-blessed iron as the town gates; it is far tougher while its wearer defends the walls.

name: Crownforged
text: Forged with gold from the mayor's own crown, it fills every ally in sight with courage and strength.

name: Emberforged
text: Quenched in emberroot oil, the weapon glows at the edge and sears whatever it strikes.

name: Featherweight
text: Enchanted to weigh almost nothing, it never slows its wearer on the march or in a sprint.

name: Guild-Stamped
text: Bearing a guild's mark, it earns its owner better prices and standing in that guild's hall.

name: Ironbound
text: Extra iron bands and rivets turn blows that would otherwise get through.

name: Keen-Edged
text: Honed by a master smith, it finds gaps in armour more often.

name: Leystruck
text: A sliver of ley crystal set in the piece strengthens every spell its bearer casts.

name: of Clean Breath
text: Packed with ghostcap and wardsalt, it keeps its owner from catching sickness off plague caravans.

name: of Echoes
text: Lets its bearer send one extra short message home each day without spending a spell slot.

name: of Far Sight
text: Its owner spots enemies and landmarks from much farther off, making their reports richer.

name: of Mending
text: Slowly heals its wearer between fights, so parties can push deeper before turning home.

name: of Reaping
text: Each swing carries through into the next foe, mowing through packs of goblins and warband rabble.

name: of Spellwarding
text: Hostile spells lose much of their force against its wearer.

name: of the Bounty
text: Bounties claimed by its owner pay out a little extra, and they seek out posted bounties more eagerly.

name: of the Gale
text: A wind at its wearer's back makes them one of the fastest things on the battlefield.

name: of the Hunt
text: Hits beasts harder and helps its wielder track them back to their dens.

name: of the Lantern
text: Gives off a steady light, so its bearer's party uncovers a wider stretch of fog as it travels.

name: of the Last Rite
text: Undead it strikes down stay down for good, and even a lich's servants fear its touch.

name: of the Merchant Prince
text: Shopkeepers trust its wearer at once: everything in town costs them less and loot sells for more.

name: of the Oathsworn
text: Bound by an oath to the town, its owner cannot be frightened into fleeing while the town is threatened.

name: of the Phoenix
text: When its wearer falls, they rise in a burst of flame with half their health, once per expedition.

name: of the Rampart
text: Allies standing beside its bearer share its cover against arrows and bolts.

name: of the Siegebreaker
text: Smashes palisades, siege engines and barricades as easily as it cuts through people.

name: of the Warlord's End
text: It strikes champions and warchiefs with terrible force; a band whose leader it kills loses heart.

name: of the Watch
text: Its bearer senses ambushes a heartbeat early and is rarely caught off guard on the road.

name: of Thorns
text: Barbed enchantments wound anyone who strikes its wearer in close combat.

name: of Unbinding
text: Each hit can strip a magical ward or blessing from its target, unravelling cult rituals and enemy shields.

name: Rimeforged
text: Frost creeps along the metal; each hit chills the target and slows its next move.

name: Roadworn
text: Broken in over a thousand miles, it lets its owner travel the wilds a little faster and tire less.

name: Salt-Etched
text: Wardsalt rubbed into etched runes makes it bite deeper into the restless dead.

name: Shadowstitched
text: Threads of dusk woven into the seams let a scout slip unseen past sentries and lairs.

name: Stormwrought
text: Forged during a thunderstorm, it cracks with lightning that leaps to a second nearby foe.

name: Sunblessed
text: Consecrated at dawn in the temple; weapons flare with radiant light and armour burns the undead that touch it.

name: Thirsting
text: It drinks from every wound it opens and pours that life back into its wielder.

name: Thunderous
text: Each solid hit lands with a boom that hurls smaller foes backward.

name: Tuskbreaker
text: Made to answer the Bloodtusk raids: it hits orcs harder and they hesitate to close with its bearer.

name: Unyielding
text: Its wearer plants their feet and will not be shoved, tripped or knocked down.

name: Wakeful
text: Its owner cannot be lulled to sleep or charmed, so cult whispers slide off them.

name: Well-Balanced
text: Perfect weight in the hand lets the wielder strike a little faster.
